caption: The drawing depicts a pair of high-waisted, light beige breeches with a fitted, tapered leg and a button fly featuring five visible buttons down the front. The waistband has four loops and an inner lining that is colored a muted yellow ochre, and the bottom hems of each leg are secured with tied strings in bows. On the right side of the drawing, there is a smaller, simplified outline of the same pair of breeches, rendered in thin, gray lines, showing the back view with crisscrossed seams and the same string ties at the leg openings. The entire composition is set on a plain, pale parchment-colored background, with objects positioned centrally and no additional items or decoration within the drawing.
title: Trousers
